mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances despite declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.2% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in >50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production signals weakening economic activity that triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns fail to materialize in >50% of INDPRO < 100 instances, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth fails to predict positive returns in >50% of 60-day horizons, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating price pressures that prompt Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in <40% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns in >50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During active Federal Reserve tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), an increase in the federal funds rate signals restrictive monetary policy that raises borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns fail to materialize in >50% of FEDFUNDS > 2.0% instances, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
